name: @butshouldwe/rush-testbed
description: Synthetic Rush monorepo fixture + spawn-based integration harness for @butshouldwe/sbom-rush and @butshouldwe/fallow-rush. Never published; invokes the plugins, never imports them.
comment-devDependencies: The two plugin entries exist for pnpm -r ORDERING only: the harness packs their tarballs, so their builds must finish before this package's tests start (pnpm runs unrelated workspace packages concurrently). The zero-import contract stands: harness code never imports them.
